associate to senior engineer in under three years, all inside nagarro...

that's not a promotion path, that's a statement.
they didn't just want to keep you, they needed to.

the resume says 3+, but how many years have you been in the game, total?
3 years and 7 months

got it.

so what kind of role are you looking for next? something similar, or a change of pace?
Both

both. i like that.

it means you want to leverage what you're good at, but you're bored of the comfort zone.

so what's the 'change of pace' you're looking for? bigger role, different industry, or just a new playground?
Bigger role same industry but product based compay

okay, a bigger role in a product company. that makes sense. you've built things, now you want to own them.

and where? bangalore, remote, anywhere?
Prefer gurgon noida delhi  Banglore Hyderabad pune remote
I've got a sense for what you're looking for. Be back in less than a minute
i'm scanning through 50,000 jobs to find the perfect fit for you. you'll hear from me soon.

Advance Engineer - Java Backend at Harman India

harman india has an advance engineer role in bangalore.

solid shot at 30-35 lpa, they're more stable than flashy.

you'll be building the backend for their connected car systems, finally escaping the services grind.

it's a chance to have your code in millions of cars instead of just another client demo.

Okay
  User clicked "Yes, interested"

this is your ticket out of the service-based grind at nagarro; you'll be building the core engine that runs their global car rental platform.

less about burning vc cash on another useless app, more about writing code that actually moves metal across continents.
